name: H07_inspiring_overseer_gains_one_life_and_draws_one_card
note: Inspiring Overseer: 'When this creature enters, you gain 1 life and draw a card.' Cast with exactly its cost ({2}{W}): its controller (and nobody else) gains exactly 1 life (20 -> 21) and draws exactly one card from the top of their own library (hand 0 -> 1, library 6 -> 5, the top card Library 5 gone). The opponent's life, hand and library are untouched.
